description: Batch execution of Bean 0070, Bean 0073, and Bean 0071 in holon-coherence: 1) Bean 0070: Harden file permissions on PKI certs, wire logs, and cache database to mitigate CWE-732 (enforce 0o700 on CA and log directories, 0o600 on CA private keys, host keys, wire log JSONL files, and SQLite cache DB). 2) Bean 0073: Expand secret redaction patterns in mitm_addon.py and payload_cleaner.py (_SECRET_DICT_KEY_PATTERN) to cover standalone 'auth', 'credential', 'credentials', 'client_secret', and 'refresh_token' to prevent credential leakage in wire logs (CWE-312). 3) Bean 0071: Fix web dashboard port forwarding in Docker run command in cli.py, binding -p {web_port}:{web_port} (or 127.0.0.1:{web_port}:8081) and verifying mitmweb --web-host 0.0.0.0 inside container, updating docs/running_mitm_sidecar_guide.md.
goal: Implement comprehensive security hardening, secret redaction, and container networking fixes in holon-coherence across Beans 0070, 0073, and 0071: 1) FILE PERMISSION HARDENING (Bean 0070): Enforce 0o700 directory mode and 0o600 file mode across src/holon_coherence/ca_generator.py (ca.key, host keys, mitmproxy-ca.pem, certs directory), src/holon_coherence/hybrid_cache.py (cache directory and llm_cache.db), and src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py (wire_log_dir, transactions.jsonl, and temporary atomic write files). Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/ asserting restrictive file modes. 2) EXPAND SECRET REDACTION PATTERNS (Bean 0073): In src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py and src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py, expand _SECRET_DICT_KEY_PATTERN to include 'auth', 'credential', 'credentials', 'client_secret', and 'refresh_token'. Ensure scrub_payload and scrub_headers recursively mask these fields. Add unit tests asserting nested structures containing auth and credentials are appropriately masked with [REDACTED]. 3) FIX WEB DASHBOARD PORT FORWARDING (Bean 0071): In src/holon_coherence/cli.py, ensure docker run command construction binds -p {web_port}:{web_port} (or 127.0.0.1:{web_port}:8081) when --web is enabled, verify mitmweb binds to --web-host 0.0.0.0 inside the container, update tests/test_cli.py with assertions for docker command construction with and without --web, and update docs/running_mitm_sidecar_guide.md. 4) VERIFICATION: Run 'uv run task test' (or pytest), 'uv run task check' (or ruff check & format), and 'npx prettier --check "**/*.md"' to verify all tests and formatting checks pass cleanly.

description: Batch execution of Bean 0072 and Bean 0074 in holon-coherence: harden cache concurrency, TTL expiration, semantic matching, and expand SSE and mitmproxy test coverage
goal: Build upon existing branch feat/0072-0074-cache-concurrency-and-sse-tests in holon-coherence: 1) HARDEN CACHE & CONCURRENCY (Bean 0072): Verify SQLite WAL mode and busy_timeout=5000, precomputed token shingles for semantic lookup, batched time-gated TTL eviction, and concurrency stress testing in tests/test_hybrid_cache.py. 2) SSE & MITMPROXY TEST EXPANSION (Bean 0074): Expand unit testing in tests/test_mitm_addon_sse.py covering mitmproxy addon lifecycle hooks (server_connect, request, responseheaders, response, _dump_flow_transaction), test streaming chunk reassembly across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), test non-streaming and fallback token estimations, test credential scrubbing, and drive test coverage of src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py to exceed 85%. 3) VERIFICATION: Run pytest, ruff check, and format checks cleanly.

description: Batch execution of Beans 0075, 0042, and 0037 in holon-coherence: decouple orphaned Phase 4 modules and decompose monoliths, add web interface token management and password support, elevate primary git installation entrypoint and document shell rehashing
goal: Implement and verify changes across holon-coherence for Beans 0075, 0042, and 0037: 1) DECOUPLE ORPHANED MODULES & FIX DOCUMENTATION PATH DRIFT (Bean 0075): Cleanly decouple Phase 4 experimental modules (OpenBrainMemory, RAGCodebaseIndexer, RingerOrchestrator) by marking them as optional experimental modules in __init__.py and parameterizing dynamic model resolution (no hardcoded model IDs). Decompose monolithic mitm_addon.py by extracting SSE/token provider parsers into src/holon_coherence/parsers/, and decompose cli.py by extracting command dispatchers into src/holon_coherence/commands/. Fix legacy monorepo path drift in docs/methods/ (replacing obsolete apps/sandbox-executor/... paths with modern holon-coherence paths). 2) WEB INTERFACE API KEY & PASSWORD SUPPORT (Bean 0042): Add --web-password CLI option to start command, support HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD fallback, auto-generate secure token via secrets.token_urlsafe(16) when not provided, persist active token to ~/.holon/web-token with 0600 permissions, forward to container via --set web_password=..., print web dashboard URL with token and password on start --web, display in status command, add dedicated 'web-token' / 'web-key' helper command, and add unit tests in tests/test_cli.py. 3) PRIMARY GIT INSTALLATION & SHELL REHASHING (Bean 0037): Update README.md to elevate 'uv tool install git+https://github.com/Holon-Agentic-Coder/holon-coherence.git' as the primary standard entrypoint, reserve editable install for local contributors, and document shell rehashing (rehash for zsh, hash -r for bash). 4) VERIFICATION: Ensure all unit tests (pytest) pass, linting (ruff, prettier) is clean, and test suite remains green.

description: Batch execution of Beans 0043 and 0051 in holon-coherence: Expose comprehensive optimization metrics in the web interface and CLI, and enable AGY and Claude Code harnesses to run against arbitrary / host-local LLM endpoints
goal: Implement and verify changes across holon-coherence for Beans 0043 and 0051: 1) EXPOSE COMPREHENSIVE OPTIMIZATION METRICS IN COHERENCE WEB UI & CLI (Bean 0043): Aggregate cumulative statistics across intercepted LLM transactions in src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py (total tool calls saved/pruned, total tokens reduced, global cache hit rate, average TTFT and decode throughput, total turns processed). Expose API endpoint intercepting GET /holon/api/metrics (and /_holon/metrics) returning live JSON metrics payload. Serve visual dashboard at /holon/ featuring real-time statistical cards (Tool Calls Saved, Tokens Reduced, Cache Hit Rate, Latency & Speedup) with auto-refresh capability. Expose 'holon-coherence metrics' CLI command in cli.py (and display in 'status' command) to print formatted terminal metrics. Update README.md and add unit tests in tests/test_mitm_addon.py and tests/test_cli.py. 2) AGY AND CLAUDE CODE RUNNERS AGAINST HOST-LOCAL LLM ENDPOINTS (Bean 0051): Support first-class endpoint and model selection in cli.py (extract_runner_flags, build_agent_env, run_agent) supporting --model and --local-llm-base / --local-llm-endpoint. For Claude Code, set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, model mapping, and suppress fallback. For AGY, set AGY_GATEWAY_URL (not GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), catalog alias resolution, and non-loopback endpoint spelling/alias to circumvent Go loopback proxy exemption. Implement protocol adapter rewrites in mitm_addon.py: strict Anthropic normalizer stripping thinking, output_config, context_management, vendor anthropic-beta headers, and suppressing injected cache_control when targeting non-cloud servers, with incremental SSE streaming pass-through; and Gemini bridge translating Gemini v1beta generateContent/streamGenerateContent to OpenAI /v1/chat/completions (or Anthropic /v1/messages) with bidirectional tool call, message, and usage translation. Retain exact cloud behavior when no local endpoint is declared. Update README.md and AGENTS.md documentation and add comprehensive unit tests. 3) VERIFICATION: Ensure all unit tests (pytest -m 'not integration_test') pass, ruff check and ruff format are clean.
